criteria.description: The learner reaches the paper states in the order the expert demonstrated.
criteria.name: Folds in the demonstrated order
criteria.observable_indicator: number of states reached out of the demonstrated order

criteria.description: Each paper state R0..Rk from the demonstration appears in the attempt.
criteria.name: Every demonstrated state reached
criteria.observable_indicator: number of demonstrated states never reached

criteria.description: No sustained folds outside the demonstrated states and no fall-back of two or more states.
criteria.name: No off-path folds
criteria.observable_indicator: number of off-path or regression events (>= 2 consecutive frames)

criteria.description: The learner reaches R1 (book-folded rectangle) in order and without off-path folds on the way.
criteria.name: Key step executed as shown: R1 book-folded rectangle
criteria.observable_indicator: R1 reached in order with a clean transition from R0

criteria.description: The attempt ends in R4 (kite form).
criteria.name: Reaches the target form (kite form)
criteria.observable_indicator: last stable state is R_k and the final frame matches the R_k checklist
